notes.title: Patches
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I'm really happy to see that you like the game; as of now we have 12 positive reviews and 0 negative (for now).

You may have noticed there have been a few updates since the release. These are mostly just minor fixes / improvements; I don't plan to be adding new features or gameplay for a while.

- Fixed a controller rebinding issue
- Fixed the last-time entry on the death screen
- Fixed leaderboards (now there's 500 entries, flawlessly rendered, with 3 display modes)
